completion_rule: Each language must have either n=150 HOST clean+MUSAN results, or a validated COMPLETE-receipt n=30 collapsed clean smoke. Collapsed smoke is HOST execution evidence but non-comparable and ranking-inadmissible; its absent noisy bucket remains UNKNOWN.

partial_capability.reason: The omnilingual-asr 0.2.0 reference pipeline returns utterance batches.

settings.execution_order: all five languages complete the clean smoke phase before any non-collapsed language expands to remaining clean and noisy samples
settings.note: CTC ignores language conditioning; codes are retained as route provenance.

selection.sort: sentence id ascending (numeric where integral), then source path/parquet row

rows.ci_method: percentile utterance bootstrap, ratio of sums

noisy_bucket.ci_method: percentile utterance bootstrap, ratio of sums
